title: G2 fix round 1: relevant_tests puts every scope module's own test file first and ranks symbol matches by specificity, so tests/test_handover.py appears for T-0256 (review T-0279)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain acbec94 "Add bounded worker context packets" (T-0266) in git log; never drop it.
Review T-0279 on T-0266 (high): spawn.packet's relevant_tests loop matches unqualified word-boundary regexes for short scope symbols (get, read, update, events, claim, db, locked, next_id), yielding 172 matches for T-0256, then applies the 15-entry cap in alphabetical file order, so tests/test_handover.py (in the task's own scope, nine relevant tests) never appears; acceptance 2 of T-0266 fails.
Change spawn.packet relevant_tests:
1. First, for every scope path: the file itself when it is under tests/, and tests/test_<module>.py for each scope module; these are always listed (uncapped, deduplicated, in scope order).
2. Then symbol matches: only symbols of at least 5 characters that are not in a stoplist (get, read, update, events, claim, db, locked, next_id, main, run, load, save, path, root, task, tasks, result, status), matched as qualified references (symbol followed by '(' or preceded by 'bus.' / '<module>.' for the scope module name) so bare English words do not match; rank test functions by the number of distinct scope symbols they reference, then by file, and fill the remaining slots up to a total of 15 entries.
3. tests/test_spawn.py: test_relevant_tests_scope_files_first (a scope with a tests/ file and a module whose test file exists: both appear before any symbol match), test_relevant_tests_ignores_short_symbols, test_relevant_tests_ranked_by_specificity; keep the four T-0266 tests green.
4. Verify in the final message: spawn.packet on /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator/tasks/T-0256.json against the worktree lists tests/test_bus.py and tests/test_handover.py under relevant_tests and stays under 4,800 chars.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows acbec94 below your commit
tests/test_spawn.py::test_relevant_tests_scope_files_first, ::test_relevant_tests_ignores_short_symbols, ::test_relevant_tests_ranked_by_specificity pass and the four T-0266 packet tests still pass
spawn.packet on T-0256's task json lists tests/test_bus.py and tests/test_handover.py under relevant_tests (final message quotes the section)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
